name: legion-router
description: Legion's multi-model brain: delegate scoped tasks to configured Codex, Cursor, Claude, and opencode executors, then bring back a verified, metered diff from an isolated worktree. Ships `legion-delegate`, executor wrappers, generic GitHub issue intake via `legion-intake` (delegate, cursor, or a compatible custom worker), the loopback :8082 metering proxy, shared cost table, and codex-json parser.
